english.title: Expose child under of two years whereby life / health endangered
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) unlawfully exposed **(..SPECIFY THE NAME..), a child under the age of 2 years, whereby the life of the said child was endangered or the health of the said child was or was likely to be permanently injured
english.legislation: Contrary to section 27 of the Offences Against the Person Act 1861.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
unlawfully exposed child under the age of 2
life of child endangered/health of child likely to be permanently injured

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: (i) See also H2118, H2084 and H2083.

welsh.welshoffencetitle: Rhoi bywyd / iechyd plentyn dan ddwy oed mewn perygl
welsh.welshstandardoffencewording: Ar **(..SPECIFY DATE..) yn **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) yn anghyfreithlon bu i chi roi bywyd **(..SPECIFY THE NAME..), sef plentyn dan 2 oed, mewn perygl neu bu i chi roi iechyd y plentyn mewn perygl mewn modd a oedd yn golygu neu'n debyg o olygu y byddai'n cael anaf parhaol
welsh.welshlegislation: Yn groes i adran 27 Deddf Troseddau Corfforol 1861.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
INDICTMENT: Five years imprisonment.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
